title: Categorical cancellation for the transpose retraction
statement: Given a scheme X, sheaves P and Q of O_X-modules, f:P → Q, an open U, and a section s:Q|_U → P|_U with s followed by f|_U equal to the identity, let e(A,B) identify restricted internal Homs with internal Homs of the restrictions. Assume e is natural in both variables: restriction of homObjMap(a,b) followed by e(A′,B′) equals e(A,B) followed by homObjMap(a|_U,b|_U). Then the restricted transpose of f followed by e(P,O_X), precomposition by s, and the inverse of e(Q,O_X) is the identity.

proof.text: Specialize the naturality hypothesis to f and id of O_X. Functor.map_id replaces the restricted identity by an identity. Compose with precomposition by s; homObjMap_comp_homObjMap identifies the two precompositions with precomposition by s followed by f|_U. Use the section equation and homObjMap_id. Reassociate the composite and cancel e(Q,O_X). These identities also apply to zero modules and the empty open.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EKP, dualizing the surjection in (2) to (3); categorical details written by S1 using internal-Hom functoriality.
proof_origin.note: Stacks Tag 0EKP supplies the dualization step, but omits its details. S1 wrote the categorical cancellation proof using the existing internal-Hom composition and identity API; the second reader checked it independently.

lean.statement:
theorem dual_retraction_key
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj Q ⟶ (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj P)
    (e : ∀ A B : X.Modules,
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (SheafOfModules.homObj
        (R := X.sheaf) A B) ≅
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)
          ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj A) ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj B))
    (he : ∀ {A A' B B' : X.Modules} (a : A' ⟶ A) (b : B ⟶ B'),
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.sheaf) a b) ≫
        (e A' B').hom = (e A B).hom ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)
            ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map a) ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map b))
    (hs : s ≫ (restrictFunctor U.ι).map f = 𝟙 _) :
    (restrictFunctor U.ι).map (dualMap f) ≫
        (e P (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)
          s (𝟙 _) ≫ (e Q (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv = 𝟙 _

statement_change.old_statement: Given a restriction internal-Hom isomorphism family e, a local section s of f, the composite of the restricted transpose with the conjugated precomposition map is the identity.
statement_change.what: The arbitrary isomorphism family was missing the naturality assumed by the proof. At U=X, on a rank-two rational vector bundle, take f to swap basis vectors and s=f inverse. A comparison changed by diag(2,1) need not commute with f dual, so its conjugated precomposition is not a retraction of the fixed transpose. Adding naturality restores the intended restriction comparison, already supplied by the sole caller.

old_proof.text: Expand the naturality equation of the internal-Hom restriction isomorphisms, then compose with precomposition by s. Contravariant functoriality of homObjMap reduces the composite to precomposition by s followed by f, which is the identity by hs. The detailed reassociation and cancellation are postponed in this intermediate theorem.
